text: Fix backlogit_ship_shipment to validate per-item completion status before archiving. Tool currently accepts any item ID in shipment manifest and deletes the queue file without verifying the item's status: done frontmatter. Items with status: queued/blocked should be removed from the manifest (not deleted from disk). Each archived item's markdown file must be moved to .backlogit/archive/ individually, not just deleted from queue. Tool must emit per-item action log [archived|skipped-not-done|missing] and refuse archive if any manifest item file is missing. See docs/compound/workflow-issues/ship-shipment-overscoped-manifest-2026-04-20.md for full incident analysis.
note: blocked-upstream: backlogit_ship_shipment per-item validation must be done by maintainers. See docs/upstream/backlogit-ship-shipment-validation-2026-04-20.md.
